abstract: Tobacco (Nicotiana tabacum L.) contains diverse chemical constituents, but information on their biological activities, plant origins, supporting literature, and experimentally accessible standards remains fragmented. Here, we developed TBACdb (http://115.120.251.12:30003/), an integrated database of tobacco bioactive compounds. Starting from 5,139 tobacco-associated chemicals with CAS numbers, multi-source curation yielded 4,634 standardized compound records, including 2,377 compounds associated with reported biological activities and 166 compounds directly supported by tobacco-focused studies. TBACdb integrates 64,522 compound--bioactivity records, 12,465 compound--species associations, more than 3.7 million literature records, and 783 physical reference standards. The database provides chemical structures and physicochemical properties, biological activities, species origins, literature evidence, statistical analysis, external database links, and digital--physical compound mapping. TBACdb provides a centralized resource for tobacco compound exploration, candidate prioritization, and subsequent analytical and experimental investigation.
